member.name: T:Meziantou.Framework.Scheduling.RecurrenceRule
member.summary: Represents a recurrence rule as defined in RFC 5545 for recurring events.

remarks.para: Supports the following RFC 5545 recurrence rule properties:

item.description: FREQ (Secondly, Minutely, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly)
UNTIL - End date for the recurrence
WKST - The day on which the workweek starts
BYSECOND - Limits occurrences to specific seconds (0-60; 60 denotes a leap second and is normalized to 59)
BYMINUTE - Limits occurrences to specific minutes (0-59)
BYHOUR - Limits occurrences to specific hours (0-23)
BYDAY - Limits occurrences to specific days of the week
BYMONTHDAY - Limits occurrences to specific days of the month (1-31, -1 to -31)
BYYEARDAY - Limits occurrences to specific days of the year (1-366, -1 to -366)
BYMONTH - Limits occurrences to specific months (1-12)
BYSETPOS - Limits occurrences to specific positions in the recurrence set
